Add an Extra Input to a Single Payslip

User manual · English · 12 steps
Learn how to add a one-off amount, such as a bonus or an allowance, to one employee's payslip as an extra input and recompute the payslip so the amount is included.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

3. All Payslips

Click All Payslips.

4. Open a batch

Click a batch name to show its payslips.

5. Open the payslip

Click the payslip to open it.

6. Worked days and inputs

Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

7. Add a line

Click Add a line in the Other Inputs table.

8. Input type

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

9. Choose the type

Click the result you want in the list.

10. Amount

Type the amount, then press Tab.

11. Save

Click the save icon to keep the change.

12. Compute Sheet

Click Compute Sheet to include the new amount.
